name: 007 First Light: Deluxe Edition
storyline: During a retrieval operation in Iceland, trainee aircrewman James Bond becomes the sole survivor after both helicopters are shot down. His defiant rescue of captured scientists draws the attention of MI6, and he is recruited into the revitalized 00 program. After months of training, Bond and his fellow recruits are ambushed by a rogue agent's assassins in Slovakia, and the attack leaves several of them dead or wounded. As Bond investigates, he begins to uncover a far-reaching conspiracy centered on Sir Nicholas Webb, an AI pioneer whose quantum supercomputer THEIA lies at the heart of a dangerous cover-up. The young agent is drawn into his first great test long before he earns the codename 007.
summary:
007 First Light: Deluxe Edition is a single‑player action shooter featuring stealth, cover‑based gunplay, and melee combat. Play as a young secret agent navigating tense missions and cinematic set pieces, with enhanced weapons and extras included in the deluxe package.

This edition includes:

4 outfits:
• Day of the Dead
• Desert Explorer
• Silent Anchor
• Gentleman Operator

Weapon skin:
• Agent’s Mark

Gleaming Pack, including 4 gadget skins:
• Gleaming Lighter
• Gleaming Earphones
• Gleaming Phone
• Gleaming Pen
